info.name: Atelie Digital - Fluxo completo da API
info.description: Rode com o Collection Runner na ordem. Pre-requisitos: Keycloak/Postgres no ar, API em {{base_url}} e 'Direct access grants' habilitado no client atelie-web (realm dev). Usuarios seed: cliente@/artesao@/admin@atelie.dev, senha dev123.

request.description: Password grant (exige Direct access grants no client atelie-web).

Cria usuario no Keycloak + conta local e envia e-mail de definicao de senha (Mailpit: http://localhost:8025).

  "first_name": "Cliente",
  "last_name": "Teste",
  "cellphone": "11999990000",
  "date_of_birth": "1995-05-20",
  "bio": "Conta criada pela collection",
  "cpf": "{{cpf_client}}",
  "address": {
    "zip_code": "01001000",
    "street": "Praca da Se",
    "number": "100",
    "complement": "Sala 1",
    "neighborhood": "Se",

    "state": "SP",
    "main": true
  }
}

exec: pm.test('404 (sem conta local) ou 200 (ja completou)', () => pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
